title: 第17章 雨夜第18章 自我修养
lines: 之前在房间里我也没有注意，这个领头居然没有出手，而是躲了起来，而没想到这人居然有枪！
在这个毫无灵气的世界，枪对我的威胁很大！
先前的搏斗让我的灵气消耗了大半，现在又对上这领头的枪口，我不由的有些紧张。
“给我跪下！”
这人冲我喊道。
我冷冷的看着他，神识也早已放出，其实我没有学过任何招式，对于灵气的认识也仅仅局限于神识，其实一个筑基修士的强大，普通人是无法触及的，尽管他手里有枪！
脑海里飞速的运转，想要找到破解之法，神识牢牢的盯着这人的动作。
“给老子跪下！”
看到我没有反应，这人抬手就是一枪。
而在他手指扣动的时候，我就动了！
拼尽全力向前冲去，子弹擦着我的头皮飞过，我没有停下，“嘭！”
又一枪，而这时，我也来到了这人的身前。
化手为刀，一下子就戳进了他的胸膛！
这领头的瞪大了双眼，到死都不敢相信，自己居然被掏心而死！
随着领头之人的倒下，我也支持不住了，第二枪子弹击中了我的腹部。
虽然有灵气的加持，身体没有被击穿，但是却卡在肉里，使人疼痛万分。
“这就是挨枪子的感觉吗？”
我苦笑道。
一屁股坐在地上，我转头看着后面的赵星辰。
赵星辰看到我坐下后，愣在了原地，不一会哇的一声哭了出来，然后飞奔向我，一下子搂住了我的脖子。
本就虚弱的我，又被勒着脖子，顿时有些喘不上气。
“你快把你白叔叔给勒死了。”
我艰难的说道。
赵星辰赶忙松手，然后急忙查看我的伤势。
看到我身上中了两枪后，满眼的担心。
“你，你不要紧吧！
你可千万不能死啊！”
看着梨花带雨的赵星辰，我一阵无语。
“放心吧，你白叔叔死不掉的，现在我们得尽快离开这里，我不确定这里还有没有他们的同伙！”
这是我最担心的，现在我这样的情况，如果再来一个人拿着枪，我俩今天就交代到这里了。
“都怪不我不好！
对不起！”
赵星辰哭道。
我摆了摆手，然后扶着赵星辰艰难的起身。
现在的赵星辰衣不遮体，浑身靠在我身上，凌乱的短发加上那梨花带雨的面容，有种别样诱惑，但是我现在却顾不上这么多。
转头看笼子里的女人一眼，外面发生了这么多事，女人在笼子里一直安静的待着，仿佛没有了灵魂。
算了，等离开这里后再来救他们吧！
雷声响起，雨接踵而至。
我扶着赵星辰，尽最快速度离开这里。
来时候的路肯定不能走了，赵星辰根本不会滑缆索，再加上我，肯定是不行的，现在只有顺着山路下山，然后走峡谷到外面的公路上去!
“一会见到人以后千万不能被发现！”
我嘱咐赵星辰道。
赵星辰点了点头，这荒山深处，真遇见人了，怕也不是什么好事！
content_en:
I didn't pay attention in the room before, but the leader didn't take action, but hid. I didn't expect that this man actually had a gun!
In this soulless world, guns are a great threat to me!
The previous fight had consumed most of my spiritual energy, and now that I was facing the leader's gun, I couldn't help but feel a little nervous.
"Kneel down!"
The man yelled at me.
I looked at him coldly, and my spiritual consciousness had already been released. In fact, I have not learned any moves, and my understanding of spiritual energy is only limited to my spiritual consciousness. In fact, the power of a foundation-building monk is beyond the reach of ordinary people, even though he has a gun in his hand!
His mind was racing, trying to find a way to solve it, and his consciousness was closely watching this person's movements.
"Kneel down for me!"
Seeing that I didn't react, the man raised his hand and shot me.
And when he moved his fingers, I moved!
I rushed forward with all my strength, the bullet flew past my scalp, I didn't stop, "Bang!"
Another shot, and at this time, I was in front of this man.
He turned his hand into a knife and stabbed it into his chest!
The leader's eyes widened, and he couldn't believe that he had his heart ripped out and died!
As the leader fell, I could no longer hold on, and the second bullet hit my abdomen.
Although the body was not penetrated by the blessing of spiritual energy, it was stuck in the flesh, causing extreme pain.
"Is this what it feels like to be shot?"
I smiled bitterly.
Sitting on the ground, I turned around and looked at Zhao Xingchen behind me.
After Zhao Xingchen saw me sitting down, he froze in place. After a while, he burst into tears, then flew towards me and hugged my neck.
I was already weak, but my neck was strangled again, and I was suddenly out of breath.
"You're about to strangle your Uncle Bai to death."
我艰难的说道。
Zhao Xingchen quickly let go and then hurriedly checked my injuries.
After seeing that I had been shot twice, my eyes were full of worry.
"You, don't worry!
You must not die! "
Looking at Zhao Xingchen with pear blossoms and rain, I was speechless for a while.
"Don't worry, your Uncle Bai won't die. Now we have to leave here as soon as possible. I'm not sure if there are any of their accomplices here!"
This is what I am most worried about. In my current situation, if another person comes with a gun, we will end up explaining it today.
“It’s not my fault!
Sorry! "
Zhao Xingchen cried.
I waved my hand and then helped Zhao Xingchen stand up with difficulty.
Now Zhao Xingchen is naked and leaning against me. His messy short hair and his charming face are alluring in a different way, but I can't care about that much now.
Turning around to look at the woman in the cage, there were so many things happening outside, but the woman had been staying quietly in the cage, as if she had no soul.
Forget it, let’s save them after we leave here!
Thunder sounded and rain followed.
I supported Zhao Xingchen and left here as quickly as possible.
We definitely can't go back the way we came. Zhao Xingchen doesn't know how to zipline at all, and together with me, it's definitely not possible. Now we can only go down the mountain road, and then go through the canyon to the road outside!
"You must not be discovered once you meet someone!"
I asked Zhao Xingchen.
Zhao Xingchen nodded. It would not be a good thing if he really met someone deep in the barren mountains!
